markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (89%)** · Confident · Careful review
Conformal set and all 5 similar cases agree, but the second model disagrees [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 89%, InSitu 11% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 1.0 | No flag raised |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Top classes differ |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 Invasive | Strong neighbor support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 4) · ↓ invasive · Score below typical; pulls concept model away from invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Few tubules; low score nudges concept model toward invasive · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 5, 8, 9) · ↑ invasive · Score high; spot check failed, so no weight [F4] · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 0, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · Score high; spot check 3/20 · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0: not shown to reflect classifier; mitoses, necrosis Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- The second model (MUSK) is right; it picks a different top class.
- Simulated resample degradation (severity 3) altered features more than reliability 0.99 suggests.

## Check on the slide
1. **4**: confirm infiltrating stroma; the validated concept scored below typical here.
2. **5, 8, 9**: look for true mitoses and necrosis; both scored high but failed spot check.
3. **10**: inferior margin tumor call lies here, yet region risk is only 6% [F7].
